q1.question: Who can use ClockBill?
q1.answer: ClockBill is built for freelancers, independent consultants, and small business owners who need to track work hours, manage clients, and bill in an organized way.

q2.question: Is it really free?
q2.answer: Yes, today it's free. ClockBill is in beta, and using it currently costs nothing, with no credit card. Going forward, managing up to three clients will stay free too. If we add paid plans for extended use, we'll let you know in advance and won't charge anyone without their choosing to.

q3.question: Can I run several timers at the same time?
q3.answer: Absolutely. If you're working for several clients at once, open a timer for each. Every timer runs and stops separately, and every entry lands in the right client and project.

q4.question: What is item-based billing?
q4.answer: Beyond hourly billing, you can bill by item: quantity times unit price. Save recurring items in each client's catalog, or add a one-off item on the fly. Great for fixes, licenses, or any work that isn't measured in hours.

q5.question: Is the settlement statement a tax invoice?
q5.answer: No. The settlement statement is an internal summary that rolls up the hours and items to be billed, for your convenience and your client's. It is not a tax invoice or receipt. You continue to issue official tax documents as usual through your invoicing system.

q6.question: Is my data secure?
q6.answer: Absolutely. Data is stored on encrypted servers in the European Union, and every user sees only their own information, even at the database level. We don't sell data and don't share it with advertisers.

q7.question: Can I export reports in Hebrew?
q7.answer: Yes. ClockBill exports reports and statements as fully Hebrew PDFs with RTL support. There are several designs to choose from, and you can upload a personal logo.

q8.question: Is there a mobile app?
q8.answer: ClockBill works great in the mobile browser and supports installing as an app (PWA). You can add it to your home screen and use it like a regular app.

q9.question: How do I set up pricing models?
q9.answer: Each client gets their own rate: hourly, monthly retainer, fixed monthly billing, or item-based billing. You can also set time rounding per client or project.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data {brand} ("we" or the "Service") collects about you, how we use and store it, and what rights are available to you. We act as the controller of the data and process the information in accordance with the Protection of Privacy Law, 5741-1981, including Amendment No. 13 to the law. Use of the Service constitutes acceptance of this policy.

collect.heading: What Data We Collect
collect.item1: Account details: email address and name, received upon registration or when logging in with Google.
collect.item2: Usage data you enter: clients, projects, tasks, time entries, items, rates, billing documents, and notes you create in the Service.
collect.item3: Technical data: a session cookie for login, as well as basic operational logs (IP address, browser type, request times) used for security and stability.
collect.note: Providing your email address is required to create an account and operate the Service; providing additional details, such as your business name, is optional. Without an email address the Service cannot be used.

use.heading: How We Use the Data
use.intro: We process the information for the following purposes only:
use.item1: To provide the Service, and to store and display your clients, projects, hours, and charges.
use.item2: To authenticate you and maintain account security.
use.item3: To maintain, monitor, and improve the system's stability and performance.
use.item4: To communicate with you regarding matters concerning your account only.
use.note: We do not sell your data, and we do not use it for advertising or disclose it to any third party for advertising purposes.

providers.heading: Sharing with Service Providers
providers.intro: We use infrastructure providers only, who process information on our behalf in order to operate the Service:
providers.item1: Neon / AWS: database storage (Frankfurt region, European Union).
providers.item2: Vercel: application hosting, as well as cookieless, anonymous traffic analytics (Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights).
providers.item3: Google: optional login via a Google account (OAuth).
providers.item4: Resend: delivery of transactional emails (email verification, password reset). Only your email address is processed for this purpose.
providers.item5: Polar: payment processing for paid plans, as Merchant of Record (handles billing, invoicing and taxes). Your billing details and email are processed.
providers.note: These providers process data on our behalf only and subject to security and privacy obligations. Apart from these providers, we do not disclose the information to third parties, unless required to do so by law or by order of a competent authority.

storage.heading: Storage and Transfer of Data Outside Israel
storage.body: The data is stored and processed on servers located in the European Union (Frankfurt, Germany). By using the Service, you consent to the transfer and storage of the data outside the borders of Israel, in a region that maintains an accepted level of data protection.

security.heading: Data Security
security.body: Traffic is encrypted (HTTPS/TLS), and data access is isolated at the database level so that each user sees only their own data (Row-Level Security). We take reasonable and accepted measures to protect the data, but no measure provides absolute security. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.

incident.heading: Security Incident
incident.body: In the event of a material security incident concerning your data, we will act in accordance with the applicable provisions of the law, including notification to the extent required by law.

cookies.heading: Cookies and Anonymous Analytics
cookies.body: We use strictly necessary cookies only — the session cookie that keeps you logged in and a cookie that remembers your chosen interface language. We do not use advertising or third-party tracking cookies. To measure traffic and performance we use cookieless, anonymous analytics tools (Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights) that collect aggregate data only, do not identify you personally, and do not track you across sites. For this reason no cookie consent banner is required.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.intro: In accordance with the Protection of Privacy Law, 5741-1981, and its regulations, the following rights are available to you:
rights.item1: Access: to view the data we hold about you.
rights.item2: Export: to download a copy of all your data from your account settings.
rights.item3: Correction: to update or correct your details at any time.
rights.item4: Deletion: to permanently delete your account and all its data, from your account settings.
rights.item5: Complaint: if you believe the processing of your data infringes your rights, you may contact the Israeli Privacy Protection Authority; if you reside in the European Union, you may also contact your local data protection supervisory authority.
rights.note: To exercise these rights you can use the tools in your account settings, contact us at support@clock-bill.com, or use the contact form.

retention.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
retention.body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. When the account is deleted, all of your user data is irreversibly removed from the system, except for operational logs that clear themselves after a short time, and except for information we are required to retain by law.

minors.heading: Minors
minors.body: The Service is not intended for use by minors under the age of 18, and we do not knowingly collect information about them.

changes.heading: Changes to the Policy
changes.body: We may update this policy from time to time. In the event of a material change, we will update the revision date and provide notice as needed. Continued use of the Service after the update constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: For any question or request regarding privacy, you may contact us at support@clock-bill.com or through the <contactLink>contact form</contactLink>.
